title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
license: Public domain in the USA; Project Gutenberg source license retained in scripts/wordcloud/fixtures/alice.txt.
method: Chapters I–XII, excluding the table of contents and license. Case-insensitive English tokens; possessive 's removed; explicit stop list; no stemming. Character/object groups are editorial labels, not automated entity recognition.
